prompt_text: Having a strong leader who does not have to bother with parliament and elections — is that a good or bad way of governing this country?

source.bucket_10_to_4: WVS Q240/V95 is a 1-10 left-right scale (1=left, 10=right). Bucketed: [1-2]=Left, [3-5]=Centre-left, [6-8]=Centre-right, [9-10]=Right. Apply this exact mapping when building real marginals at Gate 1.

prompt_text: In political matters, where would you place your views on a scale where 1 is left and 4 is right?

source.bucket_10_to_4: WVS Q250 is a 1-10 scale (1=not at all important, 10=absolutely important). Bucketed: [1-3]=Not important, [4-6]=Somewhat important, [7-9]=Important, [10]=Absolutely important. Apply this exact mapping when building real marginals at Gate 1.

prompt_text: How important is it for you to live in a country that is governed democratically?
class_rationale: Degree-of-importance attitude with no rights violation at any level; legitimately varies across a democracy and over time, so it carries the tracking signal rather than a rights floor. Original 1-10 scale bucketed to 4 (see source.bucket_10_to_4).
